question: Which mantra forms are invoked to protect the knees continuously?
premises: The knees are named as the protected part
The hrīṃ-śrīṃ-klīṃ form and a ten-syllabled mantra are invoked
inference: The hrīṃ-śrīṃ-klīṃ form and the ten-syllabled mantra always protect the knees.
plain_english: May the hrīṃ-śrīṃ-klīṃ mantra and the ten-syllabled mantra always protect my knees.
